description: A full-featured WYSIWYG editor for markdown.
command.openInSplit: Open in Split with Markdown Editor
config.isDefault: If enabled, all markdown files will be opened with the markdown editor.
config.showToolbar: Show toolbar when enabled, hide toolbar when disabled.
config.imageSaveFolder: Save images to which folder when upload in markdown, default relative to the markdown file, you can set to project root via `${projectRoot}/assets`.
config.useVscodeThemeColor: Use vscode theme's background color as the markdown editor's background color.
config.customCss: Inline CSS styles to apply to the markdown editor.
config.externalCssFiles: Array of external CSS file paths or URLs to load into the markdown editor. Supports local file paths, workspace relative paths, and HTTP/HTTPS URLs.
config.cssLoadOrder: Order to load CSS: 'external-first' loads external CSS files before custom CSS, 'custom-first' loads custom CSS before external files.
config.showOutlineByDefault: Whether to show the outline panel by default when opening markdown files in the editor.
config.outlinePosition: Position of the outline panel. Can be 'left' or 'right'.
config.outlineWidth: Default width of the outline panel in pixels.
